seat.note: Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan sought re-election and lost to former U.S. Rep. Mary Peltola (D), the first Democrat to win an Alaska Senate race since 2008.

nomineesSource: Alaska's top-four nonpartisan primary on Aug. 18, 2026 advanced Mary Peltola (D), Sen. Dan Sullivan (R), Gerald Heikes (R) and Dan J. Sullivan (No Party Affiliation) to the ranked-choice general election; Peltola led Sen. Sullivan by about 8 points in the final unofficial primary tally. Sources: KTOO/Alaska Public Media, 'U.S. Senate race will have two Dan Sullivans and a Mary Peltola'; Juneau Independent.
